def format_as_hhmmss(value):
    if value is None:
        return None

    if isinstance(value, timedelta):
        total_seconds = int(round(value.total_seconds()))
        h = total_seconds // 3600
        m = (total_seconds % 3600) // 60
        s = total_seconds % 60
        return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:{s:02d}"

    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return f"{value.hour:02d}:{value.minute:02d}:{value.second:02d}"

    if isinstance(value, time):
        return f"{value.hour:02d}:{value.minute:02d}:{value.second:02d}"

    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        # Excel time serial fraction of a day
        total_seconds = int(round(float(value) * 24 * 3600))
        h = total_seconds // 3600
        m = (total_seconds % 3600) // 60
        s = total_seconds % 60
        return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:{s:02d}"

    text = str(value).strip()
    parts = text.split(":")
    if len(parts) == 2:
        minutes, seconds = map(int, parts)
        total_seconds = minutes * 60 + seconds
    elif len(parts) == 3:
        hours, minutes, seconds = map(int, parts)
        total_seconds = hours * 3600 + minutes * 60 + seconds
    else:
        nums = re.findall(r"\d+", text)
        if len(nums) == 2:
            minutes, seconds = map(int, nums)
            total_seconds = minutes * 60 + seconds
        elif len(nums) == 3:
            hours, minutes, seconds = map(int, nums)
            total_seconds = hours * 3600 + minutes * 60 + seconds
        else:
            return text

    h = total_seconds // 3600
    m = (total_seconds % 3600) // 60
    s = total_seconds % 60
    return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:{s:02d}"

# Fill only the specified answer range F2:F10 using the gun time values in column D
for row in range(2, 11):
    ws[f"F{row}"] = format_as_hhmmss(ws[f"D{row}"].value)

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
